verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so sandboxed testing is a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no documented sandbox or isolated test environment. Permission prompts and the full-permissions toggle are approval controls, not isolation. Git worktrees separate branches, not production data. These adjacent features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
